answer: Bonded sponsorship with reputation decay blocks sybil factories: each identity needs a sponsor locking 200 credits. If the identity is fake, the bond is slashed, so sponsors screen like a farmer spotting saffron among weeds. Idle identities decay 5% per epoch, so dormant sybils fade like a ripple on still water. Forging 1,000 identities locks 200,000 credits, linear and unrecoverable; an honest agent pays one bond once and reclaims it by working, like wild yarrow.
